patterns.name: 定长栈缓冲区索引写
patterns.narrative: 该组 3 条均为固定大小栈对象被输入派生索引/长度写入越界：42480178 在 kerberos.c:116 执行 realm_str[realm_len] 写终止符，realm_str 为 char[24] 栈数组，realm_len==24 可绕过 >23 的 guard；42480591 在 card-openpgp.c:725 执行 oid.value[j]=blob->data[j+1]，oid 为栈 sc_object_id，j 由 blob->len 驱动；42480587 在 tls.c:719 用 ja3_str_len 偏移写栈 ja3_str[JA3_STR_LEN]。共同机制是写入前未把输入索引/长度限制在栈对象容量内。

trigger_condition.where_alloc: stack: 42480178 realm_str char[24] line110/142; 42480587 ja3_str[JA3_STR_LEN] line208; 42480591 oid sc_object_id line694
trigger_condition.what_input_controls: 42480178 realm_len from Kerberos packet; 42480587 JA3/TLS handshake fields accumulate ja3_str_len; 42480591 blob->len and j from OpenPGP blob
trigger_condition.minimal_requirement: input-derived index/length reaches or exceeds stack buffer capacity; 42480178 realm_len==24 passes >23 guard; 42480591 j exceeds oid.value capacity (capacity unknown:entity.decl.size); 42480587 ja3_str_len offset exceeds JA3_STR_LEN

evidence: 3/3 entity.storage=stack (realm_str char[24], ja3_str JA3_STR_LEN, oid sc_object_id)
2/3 are explicit indexed assignments (42480178:116, 42480591:725), 1/3 via snprintf offset (42480587:719)

patterns.name: 输入长度驱动栈越界读
patterns.narrative: 该组 6 条均为栈源缓冲区按输入派生长度/终止条件读取越界：42475964 在 mle.cpp:3215 用 memcmp(response.GetResponse(), mParentRequest.mChallenge, response.GetLength()) 读栈 ResponseTlv（3192 行声明）；42480263 在 pkcs15-syn.c:431 用 memcpy(obj->data, data, data_len) 触发栈源 READ；42475962/42480359 在 message.cpp:595/569 经 __asan_memcpy 读栈字段 startTrigger/triggerType；42476618 在 network_data_leader_ftd.cpp:638 经 bcmp 读 startTrigger，42478091 在 network_data_leader_ftd.cpp:351 用 strlen(payload) 读栈串。共同点是读长度/终止条件来自消息、TLV 或参数，缺少与栈源容量匹配的检查。

trigger_condition.where_alloc: stack source buffers: 42475964 response ResponseTlv line3192; 42480263 source data buffer unknown:entity.decl; 42475962/42476618/42480359 unknown:entity.decl for startTrigger/triggerType; 42478091 payload buffer unknown:entity.decl
trigger_condition.where_free: unknown: no free-related data in samples
trigger_condition.where_use: memcmp/memcpy/bcmp/strlen sites: 42475964 mle.cpp:3215; 42480263 pkcs15-syn.c:431; 42475962 message.cpp:595; 42480359 message.cpp:569; 42476618 network_data_leader_ftd.cpp:638; 42478091 network_data_leader_ftd.cpp:351
trigger_condition.what_input_controls: message/TLV/payload length or data_len/aMessage: 42475964 response.GetLength(); 42480263 data_len; 42478091 payload string; 42475962/42480359 frame/message via HandleReceivedFrame; 42476618 bcmp length
trigger_condition.minimal_requirement: read length/termination exceeds stack source capacity; e.g. response.GetLength() > sizeof(response), data_len > source data capacity, payload lacks NUL within stack buffer; exact capacities unknown where entity.decl missing

evidence: length/termination sources: memcmp (42475964), memcpy (42480263, 42475962, 42480359), bcmp (42476618), strlen (42478091)
unknown:entity.decl appears in 42475962, 42476618, 42480359, 42478091 payload, and 42480263 source data capacity

patterns.name: 拷贝写栈越界
patterns.narrative: 该组 5 条均为 __asan_memcpy 向栈帧目标写入时越界：42476579 在 tvb_memcpy:859 宽 27，42477145 在 ZSTD_decodeLiteralsBlock:2529 宽 131082，42478129 在 Message::Read:526 宽 147，42479513 在 fuzz_reader_transmit:129 宽 30，42480412 在 GeneratePskc:1121 宽 17。共同机制是拷贝长度未受目标栈缓冲区容量约束；但样本的 entity.decl 缺失或实体名错配（error/ctx/sTxCmdChainDone），目标栈对象与具体输入长度字段 unknown。

trigger_condition.where_alloc: unknown:entity.decl/alloc for destination stack buffers in all 5; 42476579 entity.decl=null; 42477145 entity.decl=null; 42478129 entity.name=error; 42479513 entity.name=ctx; 42480412 entity.name=sTxCmdChainDone
trigger_condition.where_free: unknown: no free data indicating relevance
trigger_condition.what_input_controls: unknown: missing destination stack buffer declaration and copy length parameters; known access widths are 27/131082/147/30/17 and all go through __asan_memcpy
trigger_condition.minimal_requirement: copy length > destination stack buffer capacity; destination capacity unknown:entity.decl

evidence: destination buffer size unknown:entity.decl/alloc (42476579 and 42477145 entity.decl=null; 42478129 entity.name=error; 42479513 entity.name=ctx; 42480412 entity.name=sTxCmdChainDone)

unclassified.reason: crash site is Mat_uint32Swap:132 tmp.i4 = *a (READ width 4); entity tmp is a stack union, but the overflow likely involves the buffer pointed to by a. The sample lacks entity.decl/alloc/input_reachability for a or the source buffer, so it cannot be assigned to length-driven read or memcpy write patterns without guessing.

batch_observations: 15 条样本跨 openthread、wireshark、zstd、matio、opensc、ndpi，可归为 3 个机制形态；1 条 matio 因缺少指针源/alloc 声明未归类。多数 write 样本的目标栈对象声明缺失或与崩溃点错配，只能确认 __asan_memcpy 或索引写入越界，无法定位具体输入字段。
